rules/rule-soul-fracture.skillCode: if (!context.rulePiece) return { success: false }; const deadPiece = context.sourcePiece; if (!deadPiece) return { success: false }; const playerId = context.rulePiece.ownerPlayerId; addCardToHand('soul-fragment', playerId); if (!battle.actions) battle.actions = []; const message = context.rulePiece.name + '的裂魂触发：' + deadPiece.name + '死亡，获得一张灵魂残片'; battle.actions.push({ type: 'triggerEffect', playerId: playerId, turn: battle.turn ? battle.turn.turnNumber : 0, payload: { message: message } }); return { success: true, message: message };

rules/rule-soul-fracture-player.name: 裂魂

rules/rule-soul-fracture-player.skillCode: if (!context.sourcePiece || !context.playerId) return { success: false }; addCardToHand('soul-fragment', context.playerId); return { success: true, message: '裂魂：' + (context.sourcePiece.name || context.sourcePiece.templateId) + '死亡，你获得1张灵魂残片' };

rules/rule-tails-armor-recovery.skillCode: var piece=context.rulePiece;if(!piece||piece.currentHp<=0||context.playerId!==piece.ownerPlayerId)return {success:false,message:''};var count=(piece.statusTags||[]).filter(function(t){return t.type==='periodic-heal';}).length;if(!count){removeRuleById(piece.instanceId,'rule-tails-armor-recovery');return {success:false,message:''};}var amount=count*3;piece.currentHp=Math.min(piece.maxHp,piece.currentHp+amount);return {success:true,message:piece.name+'的恢复模块回复'+amount+'点生命'};

rules/rule-tails-flight-resolve.name: 双尾飞行结算
rules/rule-tails-flight-resolve.description: 在免疫与不可操作持续时间结束时，同步结算预留搬运。
rules/rule-tails-flight-resolve.skillCode: var tails=context.rulePiece;if(!tails||context.playerId!==tails.ownerPlayerId)return {success:false,message:''};var tag=(tails.statusTags||[]).find(function(t){return t.type==='tails-flight-reservation'&&t.ownerId===tails.instanceId;});if(!tag){removeRuleById(tails.instanceId,'rule-tails-flight-resolve');return {success:false,message:''};}if(tag.appliedTurn===battle.turn.turnNumber||tag.currentDuration>1)return {success:true,message:'双尾飞行等待后续己方回合结束'};var ally=battle.pieces.find(function(p){return p.instanceId===tag.allyId&&p.currentHp>0;});var excludeIds=[tails.instanceId];if(ally)excludeIds.push(ally.instanceId);var cellLegal=function(cell){var tile=battle.map.tiles.find(function(t){return t.x===cell.x&&t.y===cell.y;});return tile&&tile.props&&tile.props.walkable&&!battle.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&excludeIds.indexOf(p.instanceId)<0&&p.x===cell.x&&p.y===cell.y;});};var tailsMoved=false,allyMoved=false;if(cellLegal({x:tag.x,y:tag.y})){tailsMoved=flow.effects.move([{pieceId:tails.instanceId,x:tag.x,y:tag.y}],'teleport').success;}if(ally&&cellLegal({x:tag.allyX,y:tag.allyY})){allyMoved=flow.effects.move([{pieceId:ally.instanceId,x:tag.allyX,y:tag.allyY}],'teleport').success;}[tails,ally].filter(Boolean).forEach(function(p){(p.statusTags||[]).filter(function(t){return t.flightId===tag.flightId;}).forEach(function(t){removeStatusEffectById(p.instanceId,t.id);});});if(battle.extensions&&battle.extensions.tileEffects)battle.extensions.tileEffects=battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(e){return e.flightId!==tag.flightId;});removeRuleById(tails.instanceId,'rule-tails-flight-resolve');var msg=tailsMoved&&allyMoved?'双尾飞行完成搬运':tailsMoved?'塔尔斯传送完成，队友落点失效':allyMoved?'队友传送完成，塔尔斯落点失效':'双尾飞行落点失效，搬运取消';return {success:true,message:msg};

rules/rule-tirion-divine-shield-start.name: 圣骑士的荣耀

rules/rule-tirion-divine-shield-start.skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; var summoned = context.sourcePiece; if (!piece || !summoned || summoned.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (!piece.statusTags) piece.statusTags = []; if (piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'divine-shield'; })) return { success: false, message: '' }; addStatusEffectById(piece.instanceId, { id: 'divine-shield', type: 'divine-shield', name: '圣盾', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-divine-shield'] }); if (!(piece.rules || []).find(function(r) { return r.id === 'rule-divine-shield'; })) addRuleById(piece.instanceId, 'rule-divine-shield'); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '散发出神圣光辉，获得圣盾保护！' };

rules/rule-ulquiorra-damage-dealt.name: 超速再生·造成伤害
rules/rule-ulquiorra-damage-dealt.description: 乌尔奇奥拉造成伤害后恢复生命并累计归刃进度。
rules/rule-ulquiorra-damage-dealt.skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece || !context.sourcePiece || context.sourcePiece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId || !(context.damage > 0)) return { success: false, message: '' }; var transformed = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.some(function(tag) { return tag.id === 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-' + piece.instanceId; }); if (!transformed) { var progress = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress'; }); if (!progress) { progress = { id: 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress-' + piece.instanceId, type: 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress', name: '归刃进度', visible: true, currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 0, stacks: 0 }; piece.statusTags.push(progress); } progress.intensity = Math.min(3, (progress.intensity || 0) + 1); progress.stacks = progress.intensity; } if (piece.currentHp > 0) context.healQueue.push({ healer: piece, target: piece, heal: 1, skillId: 'ulquiorra-high-speed-regeneration' }); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '触发超速再生' };

rules/rule-ulquiorra-damage-taken.name: 超速再生·受到伤害
rules/rule-ulquiorra-damage-taken.description: 乌尔奇奥拉受到伤害后恢复生命并累计归刃进度。
rules/rule-ulquiorra-damage-taken.skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece || !context.sourcePiece || context.sourcePiece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId || !(context.damage > 0)) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (context.targetPiece && context.targetPiece.instanceId === piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var transformed = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.some(function(tag) { return tag.id === 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-' + piece.instanceId; }); if (!transformed) { var progress = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress'; }); if (!progress) { progress = { id: 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress-' + piece.instanceId, type: 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress', name: '归刃进度', visible: true, currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 0, stacks: 0 }; piece.statusTags.push(progress); } progress.intensity = Math.min(3, (progress.intensity || 0) + 1); progress.stacks = progress.intensity; } if (piece.currentHp > 0) context.healQueue.push({ healer: piece, target: piece, heal: 1, skillId: 'ulquiorra-high-speed-regeneration' }); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '触发超速再生' };

rules/rule-ulquiorra-resurreccion.name: 归刃·黑翼大魔
rules/rule-ulquiorra-resurreccion.description: 归刃进度达到3后，于乌尔奇奥拉的回合开始时归刃。
rules/rule-ulquiorra-resurreccion.skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece || piece.currentHp <= 0 || context.playerId !== piece.ownerPlayerId) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.some(function(tag) { return tag.id === 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-' + piece.instanceId; })) return { success: false, message: '' }; var progress = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress'; }); if (!progress || (progress.intensity || 0) < 3) return { success: false, message: '' }; piece.attack += 1; piece.moveRange += 1; removeStatusEffectById(piece.instanceId, progress.id); addSkillById(piece.instanceId, 'ulquiorra-black-cero'); addStatusEffectById(piece.instanceId, { id: 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-' + piece.instanceId, type: 'resurreccion', name: '归刃', visible: true, currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1 }); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '归刃为黑翼大魔' };

rules/rule-venom-corrosion-immobile.name: 腐蚀定身

rules/rule-venom-corrosion-immobile.skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece || piece.currentHp <= 0 || !context.piece || context.piece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var tag = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(item) { return item.type === 'venom-corrosion-immobile'; }); if (!tag) { removeRuleById(piece.instanceId, 'rule-venom-corrosion-immobile'); return { success: false, message: '' }; } return { success: true, blocked: true, message: piece.name + '受到腐蚀，本回合无法移动' };

rules/rule-watcher-form.name: 红蓝形态
rules/rule-watcher-form.description: 被动：己方回合开始时，选择将平静或暴怒加入手牌。
rules/rule-watcher-form.skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece || piece.currentHp <= 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var currentPlayerId = battle && battle.turn && battle.turn.currentPlayerId; if (!currentPlayerId || String(currentPlayerId).toLowerCase() !== String(piece.ownerPlayerId).toLowerCase()) return { success: false, message: '' }; var chosen = selectOption({ title: piece.name + ' 红蓝形态：选择加入手牌的卡', playerId: piece.ownerPlayerId, canCancel: false, options: [ { id: 'calm', label: '平静（护盾2点，进入平静姿态）' }, { id: 'rage', label: '暴怒（造成1倍伤害，进入暴怒姿态）' } ] }); if (!chosen || chosen.needsOptionSelection) { if (chosen) chosen.playerId = piece.ownerPlayerId; return chosen; } var cardId = (chosen === 'calm' || chosen.id === 'calm' || chosen.value === 'calm') ? 'watcher-calm' : 'watcher-rage'; addCardToHand(cardId, piece.ownerPlayerId); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '的红蓝形态发动：' + (cardId === 'watcher-calm' ? '获得平静' : '获得暴怒') };

rules/rule-watcher-rage-dealt.name: 暴怒·伤害加倍
rules/rule-watcher-rage-dealt.skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (!context.sourcePiece || context.sourcePiece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var rageStance = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'rage-stance'; }); if (!rageStance) return { success: false, message: '' }; var baseDamage = context.damage || 0; context.damage = baseDamage * 2; return { success: true, message: piece.name + '暴怒姿态：伤害翻倍！' + baseDamage + '→' + context.damage + '点' };

rules/rule-watcher-rage-taken.name: 暴怒·受创加倍
rules/rule-watcher-rage-taken.skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (!context.piece || context.piece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var rageStance = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'rage-stance'; }); if (!rageStance) return { success: false, message: '' }; var baseDamage = context.damage || 0; context.damage = baseDamage * 2; return { success: true, message: piece.name + '处于暴怒姿态，受到双倍伤害！' + baseDamage + '→' + context.damage + '点' };

rules/rule-watcher-shield.name: 平静护盾
rules/rule-watcher-shield.description: 受到伤害时，平静护盾格挡相应伤害值（可叠加，持续1回合）
rules/rule-watcher-shield.skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (!context.sourcePiece || context.sourcePiece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var shield = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'calm-shield'; }); if (!shield || !shield.intensity || shield.intensity <= 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var absorbed = Math.min(shield.intensity, context.damage || 0); if (absorbed <= 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; shield.intensity -= absorbed; context.damage = (context.damage || 0) - absorbed; var msg = piece.name + '的平静护盾格挡了' + absorbed + '点伤害'; if (shield.intensity <= 0) { removeStatusEffectById(piece.instanceId, shield.id); removeRuleById(piece.instanceId, 'rule-watcher-shield'); msg += '，护盾破碎'; } else { msg += '，剩余护盾' + shield.intensity + '点'; } return { success: true, message: msg };

skills/aizen-black-coffin.name: 黑棺
skills/aizen-black-coffin.description: 灵压。选择敌人（5），造成1.5倍伤害。存活目标获得定身[1]。目标下回合结束时再受等量伤害。
skills/aizen-black-coffin.code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 5, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var damage = Math.floor(caster.attack * 1.5); var result = dealDamage(caster, target, damage, 'magical', battle, 'aizen-black-coffin'); var living = battle.pieces.find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === target.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; }); if (living) { addStatusEffectById(living.instanceId, { id: 'aizen-black-coffin-' + caster.instanceId + '-' + living.instanceId, type: 'aizen-black-coffin', name: '黑棺', visible: true, currentDuration: 1, currentUses: 1, stacks: 1, sourceId: caster.instanceId, delayedDamage: damage, relatedRules: ['rule-aizen-black-coffin-end'] }); addStatusEffectById(living.instanceId, { id: 'black-coffin-root-' + caster.instanceId + '-' + living.instanceId, type: 'root', name: '定身', currentDuration: 1 }); addRuleById(living.instanceId, 'rule-aizen-black-coffin-end'); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '以黑棺造成' + (result.damage || 0) + '点魔法伤害' }; }

skills/aizen-kyoka-suiguetsu.name: 镜花水月
skills/aizen-kyoka-suiguetsu.description: 秘密选择友军（4）。对方下回合该友军成为单体技能目标时，可将目标转移至自身附近的另一敌人（3）。
skills/aizen-kyoka-suiguetsu.code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var ally = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 4, filter: 'ally' }); if (!ally || ally.needsTargetSelection) return ally; caster.statusTags = (caster.statusTags || []).filter(function(tag) { return tag.type !== 'aizen-kyoka-active' && tag.type !== 'aizen-kyoka-secret'; }); var opponent = battle.players.find(function(player) { return player.playerId === nextEnemyPlayer(battle, caster.ownerPlayerId); }); addStatusEffectById(caster.instanceId, { id: 'aizen-kyoka-active-' + caster.instanceId, type: 'aizen-kyoka-active', name: '镜花水月', visible: false, currentUses: 1, stacks: 1 }); addStatusEffectById(caster.instanceId, { id: 'aizen-kyoka-secret-' + caster.instanceId, type: 'aizen-kyoka-secret', name: '镜花水月·秘密目标', visible: false, currentUses: 1, stacks: 1, targetPieceId: ally.instanceId, opponentPlayerId: opponent && opponent.playerId }); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动镜花水月' }; }

skills/aizen-shunpo.name: 瞬步
skills/aizen-shunpo.description: 灵压。选择敌人（5），传送至目标周围地格（2），获得2点临时行动点。
skills/aizen-shunpo.code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var enemy = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 5, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!enemy || enemy.needsTargetSelection) return enemy; var pos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 99, filter: 'all' }); if (!pos || pos.needsTargetSelection) return pos; if (Math.abs(enemy.x - pos.x) + Math.abs(enemy.y - pos.y) > 2) return { success: false, message: '落点超出范围' }; if (!flow.effects.displace([{pieceId:caster.instanceId,x:pos.x,y:pos.y}], 'teleport').success) return {success:true,message:'位移被阻挡，本次位移效果取消'}; var player = battle.players.find(function(item) { return item.playerId === caster.ownerPlayerId; }); if (player) player.actionPoints += 2; return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动瞬步并获得2点临时行动点' }; }

skills/akaza-annihilation.name: 破坏杀·灭式
skills/akaza-annihilation.description: 选择一个正方向，对该方向4格内所有敌军造成伤害。距离1/2/3或4格敌人造成1.25倍/1倍/0.5倍伤害。
skills/akaza-annihilation.code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var targetPosition = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 4, filter: 'all' }); if (!targetPosition || targetPosition.needsTargetSelection) return targetPosition; var dx = targetPosition.x - source.x; var dy = targetPosition.y - source.y; if ((dx !== 0 && dy !== 0) || (dx === 0 && dy === 0)) return { success: false, message: '请选择一个正方向' }; var direction = { x: dx === 0 ? 0 : (dx > 0 ? 1 : -1), y: dy === 0 ? 0 : (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1) }; var multipliers = { 1: 1.25, 2: 1, 3: 0.5, 4: 0.5 }; var targets = []; for (var distance = 1; distance <= 4; distance++) { var x = source.x + direction.x * distance; var y = source.y + direction.y * distance; for (var i = 0; i < battle.pieces.length; i++) { var piece = battle.pieces[i]; if (piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.x === x && piece.y === y && !arePlayersAllied(battle, piece.ownerPlayerId, source.ownerPlayerId)) targets.push({ piece: piece, distance: distance }); } } var totalDamage = 0; var hitCount = 0; for (var targetIndex = 0; targetIndex < targets.length; targetIndex++) { var entry = targets[targetIndex]; if (entry.piece.currentHp <= 0) continue; var damage = Math.floor(source.attack * multipliers[entry.distance]); var result = flow.effects.damage(source, entry.piece.instanceId, damage, 'physical', context.skill.id); totalDamage += Number(result && result.damage || 0); hitCount++; } return { success: true, message: source.name + '使用破坏杀·灭式，命中' + hitCount + '名敌军，造成' + totalDamage + '点物理伤害' }; }
skills/akaza-annihilation.previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece) { var attack = piece.attack || 0; return { description: '选择一个正方向，对该方向4格内所有敌军造成伤害。距离1/2/3或4格敌人造成1.25倍/1倍/0.5倍伤害。', expectedValues: { damageByDistance: [Math.floor(attack * 1.25), attack, Math.floor(attack * 0.5), Math.floor(attack * 0.5)] } }; }

skills/tails-mechanical-support.code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,t=selectTarget({type:'piece',range:7,filter:'ally'});if(!t||t.needsTargetSelection)return t;var m=c.momentum||0,heal=5+(m>=4?2:0),r=healDamage(c,t,heal,context.battle,context.skill.id);t.statusTags=t.statusTags||[];var finish=function(removed){if(m>=8){var free=t.statusTags.find(function(tag){return tag.type==='deployment-first-move-free';});if(!free){free={id:'mechanical-support-free-move-'+t.instanceId,type:'deployment-first-move-free',name:'下一次普通移动免费',visible:true};t.statusTags.push(free);}free.grantedTurnNumber=context.battle.turn.turnNumber;free.currentDuration=1;free.currentUses=1;free.remainingUses=1;free.createdTurnNumber=context.battle.turn.turnNumber;}return {success:true,message:'回复'+r.heal+'点生命'+(removed?'，移除了'+(removed.name||removed.type||'一个效果'):'')+(m>=8?'，下一次普通移动免费':'')};};if(t.statusTags.length===0)return finish(null);var choices=t.statusTags.map(function(tag,index){return {label:(tag.name||tag.type||'效果')+'（'+(index+1)+'）',value:String(index)};});choices.push({label:'不移除效果',value:'none'});var chosen=selectOption({title:'机械支援：选择要解除的效果',options:choices,canCancel:true,cancelValue:'none'});if(chosen&&chosen.needsOptionSelection)return chosen;if(chosen==='none')return finish(null);var index=Number(chosen);if(!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>=t.statusTags.length)return {success:false,message:'选择的效果无效'};return finish(t.statusTags.splice(index,1)[0]);}

skills/venom-host-transfer.name: 宿主转移
skills/venom-host-transfer.description: 选择本棋子7格内1个其他棋子，与其换位；若目标为敌人，对其施加定身[1]。
skills/venom-host-transfer.code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 7, filter: 'all' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; if (target.instanceId === caster.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '宿主转移不能选择毒液自身' }; if (target.currentHp <= 0 || target.x == null || target.y == null || caster.x == null || caster.y == null) return { success: false, message: '宿主转移只能选择场上的存活角色' }; if (Math.abs(caster.x - target.x) + Math.abs(caster.y - target.y) > 7) return { success: false, message: '目标距离超过7格' }; var x = caster.x; var y = caster.y; if (!flow.effects.displace([{pieceId:caster.instanceId,x:target.x,y:target.y},{pieceId:target.instanceId,x:x,y:y}], 'swap').success) return {success:true,message:'换位被阻挡，双方保持原位'}; if (!arePlayersAllied(battle, target.ownerPlayerId, caster.ownerPlayerId)) { addStatusEffectById(target.instanceId, { id: 'root-' + caster.instanceId + '-' + target.instanceId, name: '定身', type: 'root', currentDuration: 1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, sourceId: caster.instanceId }); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动宿主转移，与' + target.name + '交换位置' + (!arePlayersAllied(battle, target.ownerPlayerId, caster.ownerPlayerId) ? '并使其定身1回合' : '') }; }

skills/venom-symbiote-drag.name: 共生拖行
skills/venom-symbiote-drag.description: 弹射物。选择正方向，将路径上首个敌人拉至自身前方相邻地格，并施加定身[1]。相邻敌人不移动，仍施加定身。
skills/venom-symbiote-drag.code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var targetPos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 99, filter: 'all' }); if (!targetPos || targetPos.needsTargetSelection) return targetPos; if (caster.x == null || caster.y == null) return { success: false, message: '毒液当前不在战场上' }; var dx = targetPos.x - caster.x; var dy = targetPos.y - caster.y; if ((dx !== 0 && dy !== 0) || (dx === 0 && dy === 0)) return { success: false, message: '必须选择与毒液在同一行或同一列的方向' }; var direction = { x: dx === 0 ? 0 : (dx > 0 ? 1 : -1), y: dy === 0 ? 0 : (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1) }; var events = traceProjectile({ x: caster.x, y: caster.y }, direction, { excludePieceId: caster.instanceId }); var hit = null; var distance = 0; for (var i = 0; i < events.length; i++) { var event = events[i]; if (event.type === 'piece') { if (arePlayersAllied(battle, event.piece.ownerPlayerId, caster.ownerPlayerId)) return { success: true, message: '共生拖行被路径上的友方角色阻挡' }; hit = event.piece; distance = event.distance; break; } if (event.type === 'terrain' && event.blocksProjectile) return { success: true, message: '共生拖行被地形阻挡' }; } if (!hit) return { success: true, message: '路径上没有可拖行的敌人' }; if (distance > 1) { var landing = { x: caster.x + direction.x, y: caster.y + direction.y }; var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === landing.x && item.y === landing.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable) return { success: true, message: '毒液正前方不是合法落点' }; var occupied = battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.instanceId !== caster.instanceId && piece.instanceId !== hit.instanceId && piece.x === landing.x && piece.y === landing.y; }); if (occupied) return { success: true, message: '毒液正前方已被占用' }; if (!flow.effects.displace([{pieceId:hit.instanceId,x:landing.x,y:landing.y}], 'pull', {terrain:'projectile'}).success) return {success:true,message:'位移被阻挡，本次位移效果取消'}; } addStatusEffectById(hit.instanceId, { id: 'root-' + caster.instanceId + '-' + hit.instanceId, name: '定身', type: 'root', currentDuration: 1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, sourceId: caster.instanceId }); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动共生拖行，将' + hit.name + (distance > 1 ? '拉到身前并使其定身1回合' : '定身1回合') }; }
skills/venom-symbiote-drag.previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: "弹射物。选择正方向，将路径上首个敌人拉至自身前方相邻地格，并施加定身[1]。相邻敌人不移动，仍施加定身。", expectedValues: {} }; }

skills/watcher-ultimate.name: 潦草急救
skills/watcher-ultimate.description: 用【平静】与【暴怒】填满手牌。
skills/watcher-ultimate.code: function executeSkill(context) { var sourcePiece = context.piece; var player = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId; }); if (!player) return { message: '找不到玩家', success: false }; if (!player.hand) player.hand = []; var maxHand = 10; var added = 0; var calm = 0; var rage = 0; var cards = ['watcher-calm', 'watcher-rage']; var i = 0; while (player.hand.length < maxHand) { addCardToHand(cards[i % 2], sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId); added++; if (i % 2 === 0) calm++; else rage++; i++; } if (added === 0) return { message: sourcePiece.name + '手牌已满，无法使用潦草急救', success: false }; return { message: sourcePiece.name + '释放潦草急救，手牌被平静(' + calm + ')和暴怒(' + rage + ')填满', success: true }; }
skills/watcher-ultimate.previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: "用【平静】与【暴怒】填满手牌。", expectedValues: {} }; }
